text: A thick, textured greenish-brown paste is served in a square red bowl, topped with whole bright green chilies, small red chilies, dark green curry leaves, and scattered black peppercorns. Beside the bowl are several pieces of fresh coconut, showing both the white flesh and the brown husk, arranged on a vibrant purple and gold patterned cloth.

The dish consists of several cylindrical rolls made with white rice on the outside, sprinkled with sesame seeds, and filled with visible ingredients including sliced cucumber, diced red bell pepper, shredded orange carrot, and a piece of yellowish pickled vegetable. The rolls are arranged on a white plate, with some pieces cut to reveal the colorful interior, while others are topped with fresh green lettuce leaves and more shredded carrots.

Two round, golden-brown fried balls rest in a shallow pool of clear, amber-colored syrup on a white plate. A metal spoon is placed beside them, partially submerged in the liquid. The surface of the balls appears slightly textured and glistening from the syrup.

Three whole, cooked fish are laid out side-by-side on a wooden cutting board. The fish have a crispy, golden-brown to dark brown exterior with some areas appearing slightly charred or caramelized, and their skin shows patches of blue and green iridescence. Small pieces of what appear to be garlic or other aromatics are visible stuck to the surface of the fish, along with some glistening oil or sauce pooling around them on the board.
Several round, golden-brown baked goods with cracked tops are served in a shiny metal bowl. The surface of each item is studded with visible chunks of red dried fruit and slivers of pale nuts.

A thick, white, creamy substance is served in a clear glass bowl, topped with scattered, irregularly chopped pale green nuts and numerous dried, deep pink and purple flower petals. The ingredients are mixed together, with the nuts and petals resting on the surface of the cream.

The dish is a moist, crumbly mixture of pale yellow grains, likely rice or semolina, served in a white bowl with a spoon resting in it. Visible ingredients include small orange cubes of carrot, scattered black mustard seeds, and thin, translucent slivers that appear to be onion or ginger.

A thick, creamy orange-colored stew is served in a white bowl with a metal spoon resting inside it. The surface of the stew is dotted with small green flecks of herbs and darker brown chunks, likely pieces of meat or vegetables. A small white cup with a brown design sits next to the bowl on the dark table.

A mound of bright orange-red rice, mixed with small pieces of meat and flecks of red pepper, is served in a dark bowl. A single fried egg, with a runny yellow yolk and white edges, sits on top, garnished with chopped green onions.
A mound of bright orange, crumbly food is served in a clear glass bowl. The dish is topped with scattered, pale-colored slivered nuts and small white seeds.

A mound of reddish-orange, chunky stew sits in the center of a wide, shallow white bowl. The dish is topped with a scattering of thin, yellow, noodle-like strands and small pieces of bright red pepper.

A smooth, light-brown liquid fills a white ceramic mug with a handle, resting on a dark wooden surface next to a textured gray tile wall. The beverage has a uniform, creamy appearance with no visible foam, ice, or solid ingredients like fruit or nuts. A thin ring of the same brown liquid clings to the inner rim of the mug just below the top edge.

A white plate holds several large, round, puffed-up fried crackers with a bubbly, golden-brown surface, arranged around a small bowl of a savory stew. The stew consists of bite-sized, browned chunks of meat or vegetable, mixed with visible pieces of green and red chili peppers, all coated in a thick, dark sauce.

The dish consists of several large, bone-in pieces of meat coated in a thick, textured, yellowish-brown spice paste, all sitting in a pool of rich, orange-colored gravy. It is served on a white oval plate, which rests on a woven placemat with a brown and beige pattern. The visible ingredients are the meat, the heavy spice coating, and the oily, saucy liquid surrounding it.

A thick, dark green leafy vegetable stew is served in a round metal bowl, topped with a dollop of white cream or yogurt. Beside the bowl on the white plate rests a piece of flatbread with browned spots.

A round, flat, greyish-brown bread with dark charred spots is stacked on a large metal platter, topped with a pat of yellow butter. Next to it sits a small metal bowl containing a smooth, pale green sauce with a spoon resting inside, and a portion of a crumbly, orange-brown vegetable preparation. A small dollop of white, solidified fat is also visible on the platter near the bread.

Two small white ceramic cups, each resting on a matching saucer with a thin gold rim, are filled with a smooth, opaque, light-brown liquid. The surface of the drink is flat and uniform, with no visible foam, ice, or garnishes. There are faint brown smudges on the saucers and table, suggesting spills or drips from the beverage.

A mound of long-grain white rice is served on a shiny, fluted metal plate, mixed with visible chunks of red tomato, green peas, and slices of green chilies. Scattered throughout are browned pieces of onion and small, dark bits that appear to be fried spices or nuts, all lightly coated in a yellowish oil.

A round, thick-crust flatbread is served on a metal tray, cut into triangular slices. It is topped with melted, bubbly white cheese and numerous round, reddish-brown slices of cured meat that have rendered some oil. The crust is puffy and golden-brown, dusted with flour, and the entire dish sits on a light-colored wooden table.

This is a creamy pasta dish served in a close-up, filling the frame. It features penne pasta coated in a thick, white sauce, mixed with chunks of white meat that have some browned edges, and flecks of green herbs are visible throughout.

A thick, brownish broth fills a white bowl, containing visible chunks of pale tofu, shredded yellow egg, pieces of dark mushroom, and strips of light-colored meat. A white ceramic spoon rests in the soup, partially submerged among the ingredients.

A large, shallow white platter holds a thick, smooth, orange-colored sauce that pools around several pieces of meat. The meat pieces are heavily charred and blackened on the edges, with some showing lighter, cooked surfaces underneath. Finely chopped green herbs are sprinkled generously over both the meat and the sauce, and a metal serving spoon rests in the sauce on the right side of the platter.

On a white plate, there are four golden-brown, crispy fried patties with visible flecks of green herbs and dark specks, served alongside a small glass bowl of creamy white sauce garnished with a sprig of fresh mint. A silver spoon rests to the left of the plate and a fork to the right, both on a dark surface.

A clear glass plate holds several golden-brown, round fried fritters arranged in a circle around a central bowl of light brown dipping sauce garnished with chopped green herbs. The fritters are topped with small pieces of what appears to be potato and sprinkled with dark specks, likely pepper or spices. Alongside the sauce, there is a yellow lemon wedge, a red tomato carved into a rose shape, rings of purple onion, slices of green chili, and sprigs of fresh green cilantro.

A hearty stew is served in a wide, shallow metal pan, featuring a thick, reddish-orange gravy. The dish contains dark brown meatballs, chunks of yellow potato, green peas, pieces of red tomato, and slices of green okra, all topped with fresh cilantro leaves and a wedge of lemon.

A mound of mashed, yellowish-green vegetables is served on a white plate. The mixture contains visible chunks of orange carrot, pale yellow potato, and green beans, all coated in a coarse, grainy paste. Dark green curry leaves are scattered throughout the dish.

A vibrant, opaque green liquid is served chilled in a clear glass tumbler, filled with several large, translucent ice cubes that float near the surface. The drink has a smooth, slightly cloudy texture and appears to be a blended or shaken beverage, with no other visible ingredients like fruit, herbs, or garnishes present in the glass.

A thick, oval-shaped slice of dense, brown baked good rests on a white plate with a scalloped edge. The interior is studded with dark, plump raisins and flecks of lighter-colored oats or nuts, while the crust appears slightly crumbly and textured.

Two whole, dark-skinned eggplants with their stems intact are nestled in a thick, yellowish-brown gravy that is speckled with black mustard seeds and topped with a layer of red chili oil. The dish is served in a small, round red bowl, garnished with fresh green curry leaves and a few slices of green chilies.

A thick, creamy white substance is served in a rustic, unglazed brown clay bowl that has visible condensation droplets on its exterior. A small, light-colored wooden spoon rests inside the bowl, partially submerged in the smooth, opaque mixture. The only other visible detail is a small, irregular white speck or clump on the side of the bowl near the rim.
